question: Where does a test run in a remote workspace?
example: You start a test on your laptop and see the result returned by another computer.

nodes.title: Your laptop
nodes.body: It displays the interface you interact with and sends your request across the network.
items: The editor or browser takes your keyboard and mouse input.

nodes.title: Remote workspace
nodes.body: Another computer runs the test. The network carries the request and its result between the two machines.
items: A process is a running program. This one runs the test.
Project files supply the inputs for the test.

takeaway: The test reads its inputs and runs in the remote workspace. The laptop sends the request and shows the result.
limit: After a disconnection, the test can continue if the remote workspace stays on and its process survives the session.
